body_markdown:
Pankaj Porwal, General Manager Fleet Sustainability at Hafnia, participated as a panelist at the 25th Anniversary Marine Money Week Asia conference in the session, *“Financing the Maritime Energy Transition: What First Movers Are Getting Right.”* The discussion focused on how the maritime industry can accelerate decarbonization while continuing to deliver commercially viable returns.


Pankaj shared his perspective on implementing and scaling energy-efficiency initiatives across a large, spot-traded fleet. He highlighted the importance of a disciplined, evidence-based approach, from feasibility studies and project implementation to ongoing performance monitoring, to demonstrate measurable fuel savings, lower compliance costs, and stronger commercial outcomes.
